```python
def verify_d4a91cb9(I):
    x0 = ofcolor(I, EIGHT)   # blue (8)
    x1 = ofcolor(I, TWO)     # red (2)
    x2 = first(x0)           # first blue cell
    x3 = first(x1)           # first red cell
    x4 = last(x2)            # last element of first blue cell -> (i,j) so last = j
    x5 = first(x3)           # first element of first red cell -> i
    x6 = astuple(x5, x4)     # (red_row, blue_col)
    x7 = connect(x6, x2)     # line from (red_row, blue_col) to blue cell
    x8 = connect(x6, x3)     # line from (red_row, blue_col) to red cell
    x9 = combine(x7, x8)
    x10 = underfill(I, FOUR, x9)  # fill background cells with yellow (4)
    return x10
```

So typically there's one blue cell and one red cell (8 and 2). x2 = first blue cell = the blue cell. x4 = last(x2) = column of blue. x3 = first red cell = the red cell. x5 = first(x3) = row of red.

x6 = (red_row, blue_col). So the down line: connect from (red_row, blue_col) to blue cell - vertical line at column blue_col from red_row to blue_row. Then connect from (red_row, blue_col) to red cell - horizontal line at row red_row from blue_col to red_col.
